/* Tumblr Classic v2 — unified standalone/phone/notes/reblogs skin.
   This block is embedded in every independent regex renderer. */
.s2{font:14px/1.5 -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",Arial,sans-serif;text-align:left;isolation:isolate;overflow-wrap:anywhere;color-scheme:inherit}
.s2,.s2 *{box-sizing:border-box}
.s2 :is(h1,h2,h3,p,figure,blockquote){margin:0}
.s2 button,.s2 input,.s2 textarea{font:inherit}
.s2 button{cursor:pointer}
.s2 button:disabled{cursor:default}
.s2 button:focus-visible,.s2 summary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #39a9eb;outline-offset:3px}
.s2-icon{display:inline-block;width:22px;height:22px;vertical-align:middle;flex:none}
.s2-avatar{display:inline-grid;place-items:center;width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:50%;background:#73829b;color:#fff;flex:none;overflow:hidden}
.s2-avatar>.s2-icon{width:23px;height:23px;margin:0!important}
.s2-muted{color:var(--s2-muted,#8995a6)}
.s2-copy{white-space:pre-wrap;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.s2-empty:empty{display:none}
.s2-spacer{flex:1;min-width:0}
.s2-icon-button{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:6px;border:0;background:transparent;color:inherit;padding:7px;border-radius:8px;text-decoration:none}
.s2-icon-button:hover{background:rgba(128,128,128,.12)}
.s2 [data-regex-action][data-lumiverse-regex-action-used="true"]{opacity:.45;cursor:default}
.s2-status{height:45px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;position:relative;padding:0 20px;font-size:12px;flex:none}
.s2-status>span:last-child{display:flex;gap:3px}
.s2-status .s2-icon{width:16px;height:16px}
.s2-island{position:absolute;left:50%;top:10px;transform:translateX(-50%);width:82px;height:23px;border-radius:18px;background:#000}
.s2-homebar{width:110px;height:4px;margin:9px auto 7px;border-radius:9px;background:currentColor;flex:none}
.s2-shell-boundary{width:100%;min-width:0;container:s2-shell / inline-size}
/* Swarm media slot; never force a fixed aspect ratio or override inline actions. */
.s2-media{position:relative;overflow:hidden;background:transparent}
.s2-media>img{display:block;width:100%;height:auto;object-fit:contain}
.s2-media>img:is([src=""],[src="none" i]){display:none}
.s2-media-slot:empty{display:none}
.s2-media:has(.s2-media-slot:not(:empty))>img,.s2-media:has(.s2-media-slot:not(:empty))>.s2-media-alt{display:none}
.s2-media-alt{padding:13px 15px;color:#8390a0;text-align:left;font-size:12px;line-height:1.5}
.s2-media>img:not([src=""]):not([src="none" i])~.s2-media-alt{display:none}
.s2-media-slot>*,.s2-media-slot swarm-image{display:block;max-width:100%;margin:0}
.s2-media-slot [data-swarm-studio-image="true"]{position:relative!important;display:block!important;width:100%!important;height:auto!important;min-width:0!important;margin:0!important;overflow:hidden!important;border-radius:0!important}
.s2-media-slot img{display:block!important;width:100%!important;height:auto!important;max-width:100%!important;min-width:0!important;object-fit:contain!important}
.s2-media-slot [data-swarm-studio-inline-action="true"]{position:absolute!important;top:10px!important;right:10px!important;z-index:30!important;pointer-events:auto!important;min-width:32px!important;min-height:32px!important}
.s2-media-alt:empty{display:none}

/* Default is Tumblr dark. Device, explicit theme, and app design tokens may override. */
.s2.s2-tb{
  --tb-chrome:#090909;--tb-chrome-ink:#f7faff;--tb-chrome-muted:#82909f;
  --tb-bg:#0b0b0b;--tb-card:var(--lumiverse-bg-elevated,#1b1b1b);
  --tb-panel:#292929;--tb-ink:var(--lumiverse-text,#f0f2f7);
  --tb-muted:var(--lumiverse-text-muted,#a0abba);
  --tb-rule:var(--lumiverse-border,#303035);
  --tb-accent:#00b8ff;--tb-avatar:#30353e;--tb-avatar-ink:#c4d2df;
  --s2-muted:var(--tb-muted);
  color:var(--tb-ink);background:transparent;line-height:1.5;color-scheme:dark;
}
@media(prefers-color-scheme:light){.s2.s2-tb{
  --tb-bg:#001935;--tb-card:var(--lumiverse-bg-elevated,#fff);
  --tb-panel:#f1f1f1;--tb-ink:var(--lumiverse-text,#222c35);
  --tb-muted:var(--lumiverse-text-muted,#657487);
  --tb-rule:var(--lumiverse-border,#e4e9ef);
  --tb-accent:#007caf;--tb-avatar:#f1a97e;--tb-avatar-ink:#583534;--tb-chrome:#001935;--tb-chrome-muted:#a5b6c9;
  color-scheme:light;
}}
:is(html,body,[data-theme],[data-color-mode],[data-mode],.theme-dark,.dark):is([data-theme="dark"],[data-color-mode="dark"],[data-mode="dark"],.dark,.theme-dark) .s2.s2-tb{
  --tb-bg:#0b0b0b;--tb-card:var(--lumiverse-bg-elevated,#1b1b1b);
  --tb-panel:#292929;--tb-ink:var(--lumiverse-text,#f0f2f7);
  --tb-muted:var(--lumiverse-text-muted,#a0abba);
  --tb-rule:var(--lumiverse-border,#303035);
  --tb-accent:#00b8ff;--tb-avatar:#30353e;--tb-avatar-ink:#c4d2df;--tb-chrome:#090909;--tb-chrome-muted:#87929d;color-scheme:dark;
}
:is(html,body,[data-theme],[data-color-mode],[data-mode],.theme-light,.light):is([data-theme="light"],[data-color-mode="light"],[data-mode="light"],.light,.theme-light) .s2.s2-tb{
  --tb-bg:#001935;--tb-card:var(--lumiverse-bg-elevated,#fff);
  --tb-panel:#f1f1f1;--tb-ink:var(--lumiverse-text,#222c35);
  --tb-muted:var(--lumiverse-text-muted,#657487);
  --tb-rule:var(--lumiverse-border,#e4e9ef);
  --tb-accent:#007caf;--tb-avatar:#f1a97e;--tb-avatar-ink:#583534;--tb-chrome:#001935;--tb-chrome-muted:#a5b6c9;color-scheme:light;
}
/* Font contrast and per-card colors are explicit: outer phone navy never bleeds into text. */
.s2-tb .s2-avatar{width:36px;height:36px;border-radius:7px;background:var(--tb-avatar);color:var(--tb-avatar-ink)}
.s2-tb .s2-avatar>.s2-icon{width:21px;height:21px}
.s2-tb-post{width:min(100%,552px);margin:15px auto 18px;border-radius:9px;overflow:hidden;border:1px solid var(--tb-rule);background:var(--tb-card)!important;color:var(--tb-ink);box-shadow:none;min-width:0}
.s2-tb-head{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:15px 15px 12px;font-size:13px;line-height:1.25;min-width:0}
.s2-tb-head>span:nth-child(2){min-width:0;overflow-wrap:anywhere;flex:0 1 auto}
.s2-tb-head strong{display:block;font-weight:740;font-size:14px;color:var(--tb-ink)}
.s2-tb-head small{display:block;color:var(--tb-muted);font-size:11px;margin-top:3px}
.s2-tb-head .s2-tb-follow{font-weight:700;color:var(--tb-ink);background:var(--tb-panel);border-radius:20px;padding:7px 13px;margin-left:auto;font-size:11px;white-space:nowrap}
.s2-tb-head>.s2-icon{color:var(--tb-muted);width:18px;height:18px;margin-left:3px}
.s2-tb-body{padding:6px 16px 10px;min-width:0}
.s2-tb-title{font:760 20px/1.3 -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",Arial,sans-serif;letter-spacing:-.015em;margin:7px 0 11px!important;overflow-wrap:anywhere;color:var(--tb-ink)}
.s2-tb-title:empty{display:none}
.s2-tb-text{font:14px/1.55 -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",Arial,sans-serif;white-space:pre-wrap;overflow-wrap:anywhere;color:var(--tb-ink)}
.s2-tb-text:empty{display:none}
.s2-tb-body .s2-tb-text{margin-bottom:4px}
.s2-tb-post>.s2-media{margin:6px 16px 10px;border:1px solid var(--tb-rule);border-radius:8px;min-width:0;background:var(--tb-panel)}
.s2-tb-post>.s2-media:has(>img:is([src=""],[src="none" i])):has(.s2-media-slot:empty):has(.s2-media-alt:empty){display:none}
.s2-tb-post>.s2-media:has(>img:is([src=""],[src="none" i])):has(.s2-media-slot:empty)>.s2-media-alt:not(:empty){padding:12px 14px;color:var(--tb-muted);font-size:12px}
.s2-tb-post>.s2-media:has(>img:not([src=""]):not([src="none" i])){border:0;border-radius:0;background:transparent;margin:2px 0 9px}
.s2-tb-post>.s2-media:has(.s2-media-slot:not(:empty)){border:0;border-radius:0;background:transparent;margin:2px 0 9px}
.s2-tb-tags{padding:9px 16px 4px;color:var(--tb-accent);font-size:12px;line-height:1.55;white-space:pre-wrap;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.s2-tb-tags:empty{display:none}

/* Reblog chains are lightweight appended posts, not inset quotations. */
.s2-tb-chain{margin:0;padding:0;min-width:0}
.s2-tb-chain:empty{display:none}
.s2-tb-reblog{position:relative;margin:0;padding:13px 16px 12px;border:0;border-top:1px solid var(--tb-rule);min-width:0;background:transparent!important;color:var(--tb-ink)}
.s2-tb-reblog>summary{display:flex;gap:9px;align-items:center;font-weight:730;font-size:12px;cursor:pointer;color:var(--tb-ink);list-style:none;min-width:0}
.s2-tb-reblog>summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}
.s2-tb-reblog>summary::after{content:'⌄';margin-left:auto;color:var(--tb-muted);font-size:13px;line-height:1}
.s2-tb-reblog[open]>summary::after{content:'⌃'}
.s2-tb-reblog>summary .s2-avatar{width:25px;height:25px;border-radius:5px}
.s2-tb-reblog>summary .s2-avatar>.s2-icon{width:16px;height:16px}
.s2-tb-reblog>summary>.s2-icon{width:15px;height:15px;color:var(--tb-muted);margin-left:auto}
.s2-tb-reblog>summary>strong{min-width:0;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.s2-tb-reblog .s2-tb-text{margin:10px 0 0;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55}
.s2-tb-reblog .s2-tb-inline-action{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;width:28px;height:26px;margin:4px 0 0 auto!important;padding:3px!important;opacity:.72}

/* Post footer keeps native Tumblr's four icon interactions. */
.s2-tb-foot{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:7px;padding:11px 15px 13px;color:var(--tb-muted);min-height:56px}
.s2-tb-foot>.s2-tb-count{font-weight:650;font-size:12px;margin-right:auto;color:var(--tb-muted);white-space:nowrap}
.s2-tb-foot .s2-icon-button{padding:7px;border-radius:50%;width:35px;height:35px;min-width:35px}
.s2-tb-foot .s2-icon-button>span{display:none}
.s2-tb-foot [data-regex-action="s2-tb-post-reply"]{order:1}
.s2-tb-foot [data-regex-action="s2-tb-post-reblog"]{order:2}
.s2-tb-foot [data-regex-action="s2-tb-post-like"]{order:3}
.s2-tb-foot [data-regex-action="s2-tb-post-share"]{order:4}
.s2-tb-foot .s2-icon{width:21px;height:21px}
.s2-tb-foot .s2-icon-button:hover{color:var(--tb-accent);background:var(--tb-panel)}
.s2-tb-foot .s2-icon-button:last-child:hover{color:#fa467e}
.s2-tb-inline-action{color:var(--tb-muted);font-size:12px!important;padding:4px!important;margin:3px 0!important;border-radius:7px}
.s2-tb-inline-action .s2-icon{width:17px;height:17px}
.s2-tb-inline-action>span{display:none}
.s2-tb-inline-action:hover{color:var(--tb-accent);background:var(--tb-panel)}

/* Notes and replies: one continuous thread, subtle controls and clear author identity. */
.s2-tb-notes{border-top:1px solid var(--tb-rule)}
.s2-tb-notes:has(>.s2-tb-note-list:empty){display:none}
.s2-tb-notes>summary{padding:12px 16px;color:var(--tb-accent);font-weight:650;font-size:12px;cursor:pointer;list-style:none}
.s2-tb-notes>summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}
.s2-tb-notes>summary::after{content:'⌄';float:right;color:var(--tb-muted)}
.s2-tb-notes[open]>summary::after{content:'⌃'}
.s2-tb-notes>.s2-tb-inline-action{
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:flex-start;gap:7px;
  width:calc(100% - 32px);margin:0 16px 12px!important;
  padding:9px 0!important;border-radius:0;border-top:1px solid var(--tb-rule);
  color:var(--tb-accent);opacity:.9;
}
.s2-tb-notes>.s2-tb-inline-action>span{display:inline;font-size:12px}
.s2-tb-notes>.s2-tb-inline-action>.s2-icon{width:16px;height:16px}
.s2-tb-note-list{padding:0 16px 9px}.s2-tb-note-list:empty{display:none}
.s2-tb-note{padding:10px 0;border:0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--tb-rule);background:transparent!important;color:var(--tb-ink)}
.s2-tb-note:last-child{border-bottom:0}
.s2-tb-note>summary{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;list-style:none;cursor:pointer;font-size:12px;min-width:0}
.s2-tb-note>summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}
.s2-tb-note>summary::after{content:'⌄';margin-left:auto;color:var(--tb-muted);font-size:13px}
.s2-tb-note[open]>summary::after{content:'⌃'}
.s2-tb-note>summary .s2-avatar{width:29px;height:29px;border-radius:6px;flex:none}
.s2-tb-note>summary .s2-avatar>.s2-icon{width:18px;height:18px}
.s2-tb-note-identity{display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:5px;flex-wrap:wrap;min-width:0}
.s2-tb-note-identity strong{font-size:12px;font-weight:740;color:var(--tb-ink)}
.s2-tb-note-kind,.s2-tb-note-time{font-size:11px;color:var(--tb-muted)}
.s2-tb-note-kind:empty,.s2-tb-note-time:empty{display:none}
.s2-tb-note-body{padding:7px 0 2px 38px;min-width:0}
.s2-tb-note-body>.s2-copy{font-size:13px;line-height:1.55;color:var(--tb-ink)}
.s2-tb-note-replies{margin-top:8px;padding-left:10px;border-left:2px solid var(--tb-rule)}
.s2-tb-note-replies:empty{display:none}
.s2-tb-note-body>.s2-icon-button{margin:5px 5px 0 0}
.s2-tb-reply{margin:8px 0;background:transparent!important;color:var(--tb-ink)}
.s2-tb-reply>summary{display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:6px;list-style:none;cursor:pointer;color:var(--tb-muted);font-size:11px}
.s2-tb-reply>summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}
.s2-tb-reply>summary strong{color:var(--tb-ink);font-size:12px}
.s2-tb-reply-kind{color:var(--tb-muted);font-size:11px}
.s2-tb-reply>.s2-copy{padding:5px 0 1px;font-size:13px;line-height:1.5}
.s2-tb-reply .s2-icon-button{margin-top:3px}

/* Choices are a subdued inline Tumblr surface, not a separate web app. */
.s2-tb-choices{background:var(--tb-card)!important;color:var(--tb-ink);padding:13px 16px;border:1px solid var(--tb-rule);border-radius:11px;margin:10px auto;max-width:540px}
.s2-tb-choices-label{color:var(--tb-muted);font-size:11px;font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.06em;margin-bottom:10px!important}
.s2-tb-choice-row{display:flex;gap:7px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.s2-tb-choice{border:1px solid var(--tb-rule);color:var(--tb-accent);background:transparent;border-radius:16px;padding:8px 11px;font-size:12px!important;line-height:1.35;text-align:left;max-width:100%}
.s2-tb-choice:hover{background:var(--tb-panel);border-color:var(--tb-accent)}
.s2-tb-choice:empty{display:none}

/* The actual Tumblr phone: navy chrome, card-based feed and retained status/nav. */
.s2.s2-tb.s2-tb-phone{position:relative;width:min(100%,414px);height:790px;max-height:88vh;min-height:520px;margin:16px auto;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background:var(--tb-chrome);color:var(--tb-chrome-ink);border:6px solid #0e253d;border-radius:35px;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 18px 45px #0004;min-width:0}
.s2-tb-phone .s2-status{color:var(--tb-chrome-ink);min-height:44px}
.s2-tb-dashboard{position:relative;display:grid;grid-template-columns:32px minmax(0,1fr) 32px;align-items:center;gap:11px;padding:9px 17px 12px;min-height:67px;color:var(--tb-chrome-ink)}
.s2-tb-dashboard>.s2-icon{width:25px;height:25px;color:var(--tb-chrome-muted)}
.s2-tb-mobile-logo{text-align:center;font-family:Georgia,serif;font-weight:900;font-size:45px;line-height:1;letter-spacing:-.12em;color:var(--tb-chrome-ink)}
.s2-tb-menu,.s2-tb-filter{display:grid;place-items:center;color:var(--tb-chrome-muted)}
.s2-tb-menu>.s2-icon,.s2-tb-filter>.s2-icon{width:25px;height:25px}
.s2-tb-tabs{display:flex;align-items:stretch;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;padding:0 13px;border-bottom:1px solid #ffffff20;color:var(--tb-chrome-muted);font-weight:680;font-size:13px;min-height:49px}
.s2-tb-tabs>span{display:grid;place-items:center;white-space:nowrap;position:relative;padding:8px 3px}
.s2-tb-tabs>span:first-child{color:var(--tb-chrome-ink)}
.s2-tb-tabs>span:first-child:after{content:'';position:absolute;bottom:0;left:0;right:0;height:3px;border-radius:5px;background:#39baff}
.s2-tb-feed{flex:1;min-height:0;overflow-y:auto;overscroll-behavior:contain;scrollbar-width:thin;scrollbar-color:#45617e transparent;background:var(--tb-bg);padding:7px 8px 16px}
.s2-tb-phone .s2-tb-feed>.s2-tb-post{width:100%;margin:9px 0 15px;border-radius:13px;box-shadow:none}
.s2-tb-phone .s2-tb-feed>.s2-tb-choices{margin:9px 0 15px;border-radius:12px}
.s2-tb-bottom{display:flex;justify-content:space-around;align-items:center;gap:8px;min-height:54px;padding:9px 8px 4px;border-top:1px solid #ffffff23;color:var(--tb-chrome-muted)}
.s2-tb-bottom>span{display:grid;place-items:center;width:35px;height:34px}
.s2-tb-bottom>span:first-child{color:#43bbf9}
.s2-tb-bottom .s2-icon{width:22px;height:22px}
.s2-tb-phone .s2-homebar{color:var(--tb-chrome-ink);margin:8px auto 7px}
.s2-tb-phone :is(.s2-status,.s2-tb-dashboard,.s2-tb-tabs,.s2-tb-bottom,.s2-homebar){flex:none}
@media(max-width:440px){
 .s2.s2-tb.s2-tb-phone{border-width:4px;border-radius:28px;margin:9px auto}
 .s2-tb-head{padding:13px 13px 9px;gap:8px}
 .s2-tb-body{padding-right:13px;padding-left:13px}
 .s2-tb-chain{margin-right:13px;margin-left:13px}
 .s2-tb-tags{padding-left:13px;padding-right:13px}
 .s2-tb-post>.s2-media{margin-right:13px;margin-left:13px}
 .s2-tb-foot{padding-right:10px;padding-left:12px}
 .s2-tb-head .s2-tb-follow{font-size:11px}
 .s2-tb-phone .s2-tb-feed{padding-inline:6px}
 .s2-tb-title{font-size:19px}
}
@container s2-shell (max-width:440px){
 .s2.s2-tb.s2-tb-phone{border-width:4px;border-radius:28px}
 .s2-tb-head{padding:13px 13px 9px;gap:8px}
 .s2-tb-body{padding-right:13px;padding-left:13px}
 .s2-tb-chain{margin-right:13px;margin-left:13px}
 .s2-tb-tags{padding-left:13px;padding-right:13px}
}

/* Optional native Tumblr reblogger and ask/answer payload structures. */
.s2-tb-reblogger{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:14px 15px 13px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--tb-rule);min-width:0}
.s2-tb-reblogger:has(.s2-tb-reblog-name:empty){display:none}
.s2-tb-reblogger .s2-avatar{border-radius:50%;width:36px;height:36px}
.s2-tb-reblogger-detail{min-width:0;flex:1;line-height:1.3}
.s2-tb-reblog-name{display:block;font-size:13px;font-weight:750;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.s2-tb-reblog-caption{display:block;margin-top:3px;color:var(--tb-muted);font-size:11px;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.s2-tb-reblog-from:empty,.s2-tb-reblog-caption:has(.s2-tb-reblog-from:empty) .s2-tb-reblog-preposition{display:none}
.s2-tb-reblogger .s2-tb-reblog-dot{display:grid;place-items:center;position:relative;margin-left:-19px;margin-top:26px;width:17px;height:17px;border-radius:50%;background:#00c95b;color:white;border:1px solid var(--tb-card);flex:none;z-index:1}
.s2-tb-reblog-dot .s2-icon{width:12px;height:12px}
.s2-tb-reblogger>.s2-icon{color:var(--tb-muted);width:19px;height:19px}
.s2-tb-post:has(>.s2-tb-reblogger .s2-tb-reblog-name:not(:empty))>.s2-tb-head .s2-avatar{border-radius:50%}
.s2-tb-post:has(>.s2-tb-reblogger .s2-tb-reblog-name:not(:empty))>.s2-tb-head{padding-top:14px}
.s2-tb-avatar-image{display:block;position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}
.s2-tb .s2-avatar{position:relative}
.s2-tb-avatar-image:is([src=""],[src="none" i]){display:none}
.s2-tb .s2-avatar:has(>.s2-tb-avatar-image:not([src=""]):not([src="none" i]))>.s2-icon{display:none}
.s2-tb-ask-stack{margin:2px 16px 7px;display:grid;gap:10px}

/* TWITTER CLASSIC THEME + THREAD COMPOSITION | one shared layer */
.s2.s2-tw{
  --s2-tw-bg:var(--lumiverse-bg,#101114);
  --s2-tw-panel:var(--lumiverse-bg-elevated,#1c1f25);
  --s2-tw-ink:var(--lumiverse-text,#eff3f4);
  --s2-tw-secondary:var(--lumiverse-text-muted,#9da8b2);
  --s2-tw-border:var(--lumiverse-border,#353b43);
  --s2-tw-accent:#1d9bf0;
  --s2-tw-hover:color-mix(in srgb,var(--s2-tw-panel) 82%,var(--s2-tw-ink) 18%);
  --s2-tw-soft:color-mix(in srgb,var(--s2-tw-bg) 65%,var(--s2-tw-panel) 35%);
  --s2-muted:var(--s2-tw-secondary);
  color:var(--s2-tw-ink);background:var(--s2-tw-bg);color-scheme:inherit;
}
@media(prefers-color-scheme:light){.s2.s2-tw{
  --s2-tw-bg:var(--lumiverse-bg,#fff);
  --s2-tw-panel:var(--lumiverse-bg-elevated,#eff3f4);
  --s2-tw-ink:var(--lumiverse-text,#0f1419);
  --s2-tw-secondary:var(--lumiverse-text-muted,#536471);
  --s2-tw-border:var(--lumiverse-border,#cfd9de);
}}
:where(html,body):is([data-theme="dark"],[data-color-mode="dark"],[data-mode="dark"],.dark,.theme-dark) .s2.s2-tw{
  --s2-tw-bg:var(--lumiverse-bg,#101114);--s2-tw-panel:var(--lumiverse-bg-elevated,#1c1f25);
  --s2-tw-ink:var(--lumiverse-text,#eff3f4);--s2-tw-secondary:var(--lumiverse-text-muted,#9da8b2);
  --s2-tw-border:var(--lumiverse-border,#353b43);
}
:where(html,body):is([data-theme="light"],[data-color-mode="light"],[data-mode="light"],.light,.theme-light) .s2.s2-tw{
  --s2-tw-bg:var(--lumiverse-bg,#fff);--s2-tw-panel:var(--lumiverse-bg-elevated,#eff3f4);
  --s2-tw-ink:var(--lumiverse-text,#0f1419);--s2-tw-secondary:var(--lumiverse-text-muted,#536471);
  --s2-tw-border:var(--lumiverse-border,#cfd9de);
}
.s2.s2-tw:is(.s2-tw-post,.s2-tw-desktop,.s2-tw-choices),
.s2-tw :is(.s2-tw-post,.s2-tw-choices,.s2-tw-desktop){
  color:var(--s2-tw-ink);background:var(--s2-tw-bg);border-color:var(--s2-tw-border)
}
.s2-tw .s2-avatar{background:var(--s2-tw-panel);color:var(--s2-tw-secondary)}
.s2-tw :is(.s2-tw-retweeted,.s2-tw-handle,.s2-tw-time,.s2-tw-metrics,.s2-tw-controls,.s2-tw-choices-label,.s2-tw-quote-context,.s2-tw-search,.s2-tw-compose,.s2-tw-timeline-tabs,.s2-tw-aside-footer,.s2-media-alt),
.s2-tw .s2-tw-identity>.s2-icon,.s2-tw .s2-tw-nav-profile small,.s2-tw .s2-tw-trend small{color:var(--s2-tw-secondary)}
.s2-tw .s2-tw-timeline-tabs>span:first-child{color:var(--s2-tw-ink)}
.s2-tw :is(.s2-tw-post,.s2-tw-repost-thread,.s2-tw-choice,.s2-tw-timeline,.s2-tw-timeline-tabs,.s2-tw-compose,.s2-tw-quote>.s2-tw-interaction-body,.s2-tw-thread,.s2-tw-reposts,.s2-tw-reply,.s2-tw-quote,.s2-tw-choices),
.s2-tw .s2-tw-content>.s2-media,.s2-tw .s2-tw-timeline-content>.s2-tw-post,
.s2-tw .s2-tw-timeline-content>.s2-tw-choices{border-color:var(--s2-tw-border)}
.s2-tw .s2-media{background:var(--s2-tw-panel)}
.s2-tw :is(.s2-tw-search,.s2-tw-trends){background:var(--s2-tw-panel)}
.s2-tw .s2-tw-choice{background:var(--s2-tw-bg);color:var(--s2-tw-accent)}
.s2-tw .s2-tw-choice:hover{background:var(--s2-tw-hover)}
.s2-tw .s2-tw-controls .s2-icon-button:hover{background:var(--s2-tw-hover);color:var(--s2-tw-accent)}
.s2-tw .s2-tw-controls .s2-tw-like:hover{background:color-mix(in srgb,#f91880 14%,var(--s2-tw-bg));color:#f91880}
.s2-tw .s2-tw-nav-tweet{background:var(--s2-tw-accent);color:#fff}


/* The two standalone mini-cards use the same composition. */
.s2.s2-tw:is(.s2-tw-reply,.s2-tw-quote){
  width:min(100%,600px);margin:12px auto;padding:14px 16px;
  border:1px solid var(--s2-tw-border);border-radius:13px;
  background:var(--s2-tw-bg);color:var(--s2-tw-ink);
}
/* Bird-era Twitter: restrained thread dividers and native-style control icons. */
.s2-tw :is(.s2-tw-thread,.s2-tw-reposts){margin-top:4px;border-top:1px solid var(--s2-tw-border)}
.s2-tw :is(.s2-tw-thread,.s2-tw-reposts)>summary{
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;list-style:none;
  padding:12px 16px;background:transparent;color:var(--s2-tw-accent);
  font-size:12px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:0;line-height:1.4;
}
.s2-tw :is(.s2-tw-thread,.s2-tw-reposts)>summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}
.s2-tw :is(.s2-tw-thread,.s2-tw-reposts)>summary::before{content:none}
.s2-tw :is(.s2-tw-thread,.s2-tw-reposts)>summary::after{
  content:'';display:block;width:6px;height:6px;flex:none;margin-left:auto;
  border:solid currentColor;border-width:0 1.5px 1.5px 0;transform:rotate(225deg);
  background:none;border-radius:0;opacity:.65;
}
.s2-tw :is(.s2-tw-thread,.s2-tw-reposts):not([open])>summary::after{transform:rotate(45deg)}
.s2-tw .s2-tw-thread-body{padding:0 16px 8px;min-width:0}

/* Reply rows are ordinary tweets in a timeline, not bordered accordion cards. */
.s2-tw .s2-tw-thread-body>.s2-tw-reply,
.s2-tw .s2-tw-thread-body>.s2-tw-quote{
  position:relative;margin:0;padding:13px 0 12px;border:0;
  border-bottom:1px solid var(--s2-tw-border);background:transparent;
}
.s2-tw .s2-tw-thread-body>:last-child:is(.s2-tw-reply,.s2-tw-quote){border-bottom:0}
:is(.s2-tw-reply,.s2-tw-quote)>summary{
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;min-width:0;list-style:none;
  padding:0;color:var(--s2-tw-ink);font-size:13px;line-height:1.35;
}
:is(.s2-tw-reply,.s2-tw-quote)>summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}
:is(.s2-tw-reply,.s2-tw-quote)>summary>.s2-avatar{
  width:38px;height:38px;flex:none;background:var(--s2-tw-panel);border:0;
}
:is(.s2-tw-reply,.s2-tw-quote)>summary>span:last-of-type{
  flex:1;min-width:0;overflow-wrap:anywhere;
}
:is(.s2-tw-reply,.s2-tw-quote)>summary strong{
  color:var(--s2-tw-ink);font-size:13px;font-weight:730;
}
:is(.s2-tw-reply,.s2-tw-quote)>summary .s2-tw-handle,
:is(.s2-tw-reply,.s2-tw-quote)>summary .s2-tw-time{
  color:var(--s2-tw-secondary);font-size:12px;
}
:is(.s2-tw-reply,.s2-tw-quote)>summary::after{
  content:'⌃';width:auto;height:auto;display:block;margin-left:auto;
  color:var(--s2-tw-secondary);font-size:13px;line-height:1;
  border:0;border-radius:0;background:transparent;opacity:0;
}
:is(.s2-tw-reply,.s2-tw-quote):not([open])>summary::after{content:'⌄'}
:is(.s2-tw-reply,.s2-tw-quote)>summary:hover::after,
:is(.s2-tw-reply,.s2-tw-quote)>summary:focus-visible::after{opacity:.7}
.s2-tw-reply>.s2-tw-interaction-body,
.s2-tw-quote>.s2-tw-interaction-body{padding:4px 0 0 48px;min-width:0}
.s2-tw .s2-tw-interaction-body>.s2-copy{color:var(--s2-tw-ink);font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;overflow-wrap:anywhere}

/* Icon-only toolbar, exactly as in a tweet. Labels remain in aria-label/title. */
.s2-tw .s2-tw-mini-actions,
.s2.s2-tw .s2-tw-mini-actions{
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;
  width:min(100%,160px);min-width:0;gap:16px;margin:5px 0 0;
  padding:0;border:0;background:transparent;
}
.s2-tw .s2-tw-mini-actions>.s2-tw-mini-action,
.s2.s2-tw .s2-tw-mini-actions>.s2-tw-mini-action{
  display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  width:34px;height:32px;min-width:34px;min-height:32px;
  margin:0!important;padding:0!important;gap:0;
  color:var(--s2-tw-secondary);background:transparent;
  border:0;border-radius:50%;box-shadow:none;
  font-size:12px!important;line-height:1!important;
}
.s2-tw .s2-tw-mini-actions>.s2-tw-mini-action .s2-icon{width:19px;height:19px}
.s2-tw .s2-tw-mini-actions>.s2-tw-mini-action>span{display:none}
.s2-tw .s2-tw-mini-actions>.s2-tw-mini-action:hover,
.s2-tw .s2-tw-mini-actions>.s2-tw-mini-action:focus-visible{
  color:var(--s2-tw-accent);background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--s2-tw-accent) 12%,transparent);
}
.s2-tw .s2-tw-mini-actions>.s2-tw-mini-action[data-regex-action$='like']:hover,
.s2-tw .s2-tw-mini-actions>.s2-tw-mini-action[data-regex-action$='like']:focus-visible{
  color:#f91880;background:color-mix(in srgb,#f91880 12%,transparent);
}
.s2-tw .s2-tw-mini-actions>[data-lumiverse-regex-action-used='true']{opacity:.5}

/* Proper embedded quoted tweet: no decorative blue quotation strip. */
.s2-tw-quote>.s2-tw-interaction-body{
  margin:0;padding:4px 0 0 48px;border:0;
  border-radius:0;background:transparent;min-width:0;
}
.s2-tw .s2-tw-quote>.s2-tw-interaction-body>.s2-copy{font-size:14px;line-height:1.55}
.s2-tw .s2-tw-quote-embed{
  display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:9px;
  margin:10px 0 1px;padding:11px 12px;
  border:1px solid var(--s2-tw-border);border-radius:13px;
  background:var(--s2-tw-bg);min-width:0;
}
.s2-tw .s2-tw-quote-embed:has(>.s2-tw-quote-context:empty){display:none}
.s2-tw .s2-tw-quote-embed>.s2-tw-quoted-avatar{
  display:inline-grid;place-items:center;flex:none;
  width:27px;height:27px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--s2-tw-panel);
  color:var(--s2-tw-secondary);
}
.s2-tw .s2-tw-quoted-avatar>.s2-icon{width:17px;height:17px}
.s2-tw .s2-tw-quote-context{
  display:block;min-width:0;margin:2px 0 0!important;padding:0;
  color:var(--s2-tw-ink);font-size:12px;line-height:1.55;
  border:0;border-left:0;border-radius:0;background:transparent;overflow-wrap:anywhere;
}
.s2-tw .s2-tw-repost-thread{
  margin:6px 0 0;padding:3px 0 0;border:0;
  background:transparent;min-width:0;
}
.s2-tw .s2-tw-repost-thread:empty{display:none}
.s2-tw .s2-tw-repost-thread>.s2-tw-reply{
  margin:0;padding:11px 0 7px;border:0;border-top:1px solid var(--s2-tw-border);
  background:transparent;
}
.s2-tw .s2-tw-repost-thread>.s2-tw-reply:not(:first-child){margin-top:7px}
.s2-tw .s2-tw-repost-thread>.s2-tw-reply>.s2-tw-interaction-body{padding:4px 0 0 48px}
/* Nested `details.s2` must NOT inherit the standalone bordered-card treatment. */
.s2-tw .s2-tw-thread-body>.s2.s2-tw:is(.s2-tw-reply,.s2-tw-quote){
  width:100%;margin:0;padding:13px 0 12px;
  border:0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--s2-tw-border);
  border-radius:0;box-shadow:none;background:transparent;
}
.s2-tw .s2-tw-thread-body>.s2.s2-tw:is(.s2-tw-reply,.s2-tw-quote):last-child{border-bottom:0}
.s2-tw .s2-tw-repost-thread>.s2.s2-tw.s2-tw-reply{
  width:100%;margin:0;padding:11px 0 7px;
  border:0;border-top:1px solid var(--s2-tw-border);
  border-radius:0;box-shadow:none;background:transparent;
}
@media(max-width:520px){
  .s2-tw .s2-tw-thread-body{padding:0 12px 8px}
  .s2-tw-quote>.s2-tw-interaction-body{padding-left:42px}
  .s2-tw-reply>.s2-tw-interaction-body{padding-left:42px}
  .s2-tw .s2-tw-quote-embed{padding:9px 10px}
  .s2-tw .s2-tw-repost-thread>.s2-tw-reply>.s2-tw-interaction-body{padding-left:42px}
}
@container s2-shell (max-width:520px){
  .s2-tw .s2-tw-thread-body{padding:0 12px 8px}
  .s2-tw-quote>.s2-tw-interaction-body{padding-left:42px}
  .s2-tw-reply>.s2-tw-interaction-body{padding-left:42px}
  .s2-tw .s2-tw-quote-embed{padding:9px 10px}

<!-- social-v2-tumblr-desktop:start --><style>

.s2-tb-title{font:760 20px/1.3 -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",Arial,sans-serif;letter-spacing:-.015em;margin:7px 0 11px!important;overflow-wrap:anywhere;color:var(--tb-ink)}

/* TWITTER CLASSIC THEME + THREAD COMPOSITION | one shared layer */
.s2.s2-tw{
  --s2-tw-bg:var(--lumiverse-bg,#101114);

  --s2-tw-ink:var(--lumiverse-text,#eff3f4);
  --s2-tw-secondary:var(--lumiverse-text-muted,#9da8b2);
  --s2-tw-border:var(--lumiverse-border,#353b43);
  --s2-tw-accent:#1d9bf0;
  --s2-tw-hover:color-mix(in srgb,var(--s2-tw-panel) 82%,var(--s2-tw-ink) 18%);
  --s2-tw-soft:color-mix(in srgb,var(--s2-tw-bg) 65%,var(--s2-tw-panel) 35%);
  --s2-muted:var(--s2-tw-secondary);
  color:var(--s2-tw-ink);background:var(--s2-tw-bg);color-scheme:inherit;
}
@media(prefers-color-scheme:light){.s2.s2-tw{
  --s2-tw-bg:var(--lumiverse-bg,#fff);

  --s2-tw-border:var(--lumiverse-border,#cfd9de);

/* The two standalone mini-cards use the same composition. */
.s2.s2-tw:is(.s2-tw-reply,.s2-tw-quote){
  width:min(100%,600px);margin:12px auto;padding:14px 16px;
  border:1px solid var(--s2-tw-border);border-radius:13px;
  background:var(--s2-tw-bg);color:var(--s2-tw-ink);

  content:'';display:block;width:6px;height:6px;flex:none;margin-left:auto;

  background:none;border-radius:0;opacity:.65;

.s2-tw .s2-tw-thread-body{padding:0 16px 8px;min-width:0}

/* TWITTER CLASSIC THEME + THREAD COMPOSITION | one shared layer */
.s2.s2-tw{
  --s2-tw-bg:var(--lumiverse-bg,#101114);
  --s2-tw-panel:var(--lumiverse-bg-elevated,#1c1f25);
  --s2-tw-ink:var(--lumiverse-text,#eff3f4);
  --s2-tw-secondary:var(--lumiverse-text-muted,#9da8b2);
  --s2-tw-border:var(--lumiverse-border,#353b43);
  --s2-tw-accent:#1d9bf0;
  --s2-tw-hover:color-mix(in srgb,var(--s2-tw-panel) 82%,var(--s2-tw-ink) 18%);
  --s2-tw-soft:color-mix(in srgb,var(--s2-tw-bg) 65%,var(--s2-tw-panel) 35%);
  --s2-muted:var(--s2-tw-secondary);
  color:var(--s2-tw-ink);background:var(--s2-tw-bg);color-scheme:inherit;
}
@media(prefers-color-scheme:light){.s2.s2-tw{
  --s2-tw-bg:var(--lumiverse-bg,#fff);
  --s2-tw-panel:var(--lumiverse-bg-elevated,#eff3f4);
  --s2-tw-ink:var(--lumiverse-text,#0f1419);
  --s2-tw-secondary:var(--lumiverse-text-muted,#536471);
  --s2-tw-border:var(--lumiverse-border,#cfd9de);
}}

  --s2-tw-bg:var(--lumiverse-bg,#101114);--s2-tw-panel:var(--lumiverse-bg-elevated,#1c1f25);
  --s2-tw-ink:var(--lumiverse-text,#eff3f4);--s2-tw-secondary:var(--lumiverse-text-muted,#9da8b2);
  --s2-tw-border:var(--lumiverse-border,#353b43);
}
:where(html,body):is([data-theme="light"],[data-color-mode="light"],[data-mode="light"],.light,.theme-light) .s2.s2-tw{

  --s2-tw-ink:var(--lumiverse-text,#0f1419);--s2-tw-secondary:var(--lumiverse-text-muted,#536471);

}

/* The two standalone mini-cards use the same composition. */
.s2.s2-tw:is(.s2-tw-reply,.s2-tw-quote){
  width:min(100%,600px);margin:12px auto;padding:14px 16px;
  border:1px solid var(--s2-tw-border);border-radius:13px;
  background:var(--s2-tw-bg);color:var(--s2-tw-ink);
}
/* Bird-era Twitter: restrained thread dividers and native-style control icons. */
.s2-tw :is(.s2-tw-thread,.s2-tw-reposts){margin-top:4px;border-top:1px solid var(--s2-tw-border)}
.s2-tw :is(.s2-tw-thread,.s2-tw-reposts)>summary{
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;list-style:none;

  font-size:12px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:0;line-height:1.4;

.s2-tw :is(.s2-tw-thread,.s2-tw-reposts)>summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}

.s2-tw :is(.s2-tw-thread,.s2-tw-reposts)>summary::after{
  content:'';display:block;width:6px;height:6px;flex:none;margin-left:auto;
  border:solid currentColor;border-width:0 1.5px 1.5px 0;transform:rotate(225deg);
  background:none;border-radius:0;opacity:.65;

.s2-tw .s2-tw-thread-body{padding:0 16px 8px;min-width:0}

.s2-tw .s2-tw-thread-body>.s2-tw-reply,
.s2-tw .s2-tw-thread-body>.s2-tw-quote{
  position:relative;margin:0;padding:13px 0 12px;border:0;

  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;min-width:0;list-style:none;
  padding:0;color:var(--s2-tw-ink);font-size:13px;line-height:1.35;

:is(.s2-tw-reply,.s2-tw-quote)>summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}
:is(.s2-tw-reply,.s2-tw-quote)>summary>.s2-avatar{

  flex:1;min-width:0;overflow-wrap:anywhere;
}
:is(.s2-tw-reply,.s2-tw-quote)>summary strong{

}
:is(.s2-tw-reply,.s2-tw-quote)>summary .s2-tw-handle,
:is(.s2-tw-reply,.s2-tw-quote)>summary .s2-tw-time{
  color:var(--s2-tw-secondary);font-size:12px;

  content:'⌃';width:auto;height:auto;display:block;margin-left:auto;
